title: 8 新的任务，抱孙翔
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

越云宿舍。

周珈蓝蜷缩在电竞椅上。

她穿着队服，可是太瘦了，宽松运动服反而把她衬得更伶仃纤细，像插在花瓶里的纤细花茎，纯白色长卷发披垂下来，很多又很蓬松，她发抖时头发也跟着颤动，轻盈而柔软，像花瓣。

系统在她脑海中发起警报。

【检测到目标人物，孙翔/张佳乐。】

【任务生成中，任务已生成。】

【要求：在嘉世俱乐部楼下与孙翔拥抱/在越云俱乐部楼下与张佳乐拥抱。】

这是第二次触发现实任务，二选一。

周珈蓝选了孙翔。

系统安静下来，开始倒计时。

手机弹出孙翔的负面通稿，上次爆出了他和叶秋的录音，舆论环境立刻变得不友好起来。

今晚他带队嘉世对战三零一，结果还没出来。

周珈蓝翻到比赛直播看了一会儿，孙翔擂台赛一穿三，全场欢呼，他眉眼锋利，神色傲慢。

年少轻狂，仿佛天地都要被他踩在脚下。

团队赛即将开始，周珈蓝不了解嘉世，但是可能她这个人太悲观，下意识脑补如果孙翔输了。

舆论会立刻像火苗一样见风就长，辱骂的声音铺天盖地，所有人都质疑他的实力乃至人格。

最佳新人、从前的辉煌战绩、出道一年半接手一叶之秋账号卡……过往所有成就都被翻出来审判，再推翻。

所有人都可以来看不起他，他会在互联网的世界里变成一条丧家之犬。

如果我输了，也会这样吧。但是我不会在乎，因为我生存的意义不是这个。

只要系统不离开我，我就不会死，我就可以好好地活下去。

周珈蓝拿出手机，定了最近一班飞往H市的机票。

然后拖出键盘打字。

美杜莎：要出门。

浅花迷人：好，下次教你怎么打狂剑。

美杜莎：不。

美杜莎：学，打枪系。

然后她拔卡下线，拿了外套罩在队服外面，出门下楼打车，目的地机场。

往后的职业赛场上，她会遇到王杰希，会遇到黄少天，但她盯上的是周泽楷。

不是因为两个人相近的血缘和迥异的命运。

周珈蓝没那么无聊，她好不容易等来一次命运翻盘的机会，现在想要做的只是好好活下去。

关注周泽楷，因为周泽楷出道年份与她最接近，人设定位也跟她最相似，漂亮的操作，漂亮的脸。

如果能赢他，收获会最大。

她运气很好，找到了很厉害的陪练，周泽楷现在声势喧天，但周珈蓝不认为周泽楷会比张佳乐更强到哪里。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yueyun dormitory.

Zhou Jialan curled up on the gaming chair.

She was wearing a team uniform, but she was too thin. The loose sportswear made her even more lonely and slender, like a slender flower stem in a vase. Her long pure white curly hair hung down, many and fluffy. When she shivered, her hair also trembled, light and soft, like petals.

The system set off an alarm in her mind.

[Target person detected, Sun Xiang/Zhang Jiale.】

[Task generation in progress, the task has been generated.】

[Requirement: Hug Sun Xiang downstairs at Club Excellent Era/hug Zhang Jiale downstairs at Yueyun Club.】

This is the second time to trigger a real-life mission, choose one of the two.

Zhou Jialan chose Sun Xiang.

The system goes quiet and starts counting down.

A negative press release from Sun Xiang popped up on the phone. The recording of him and Ye Qiu was revealed last time, and the public opinion environment immediately became unfriendly.

Tonight he led Excellent Era against 301, but the result hasn't come out yet.

Zhou Jialan turned to the live broadcast of the game and watched it for a while. Sun Xiang scored three times in the arena, and the audience cheered. He had sharp eyebrows and an arrogant expression.

He was young and frivolous, as if the world would be trampled under his feet.

The team competition was about to begin. Zhou Jialan didn't know Excellent Era, but maybe she was too pessimistic and subconsciously thought about what would happen if Sun Xiang lost.

Public opinion will immediately grow like a flame, and the voices of abuse will be overwhelming. Everyone will question his strength and even personality.

The best newcomer, the glorious record in the past, taking over the account card of One Autumn Leaf a year and a half after his debut... all the past achievements have been reviewed, judged, and overturned.

Everyone can look down on him, and he will become a lost dog in the world of the Internet.

It would be the same if I lost.But I don't care, because this is not the meaning of my existence.

As long as the system does not leave me, I will not die and I can live well.

Zhou Jialan took out his mobile phone and booked the latest flight to H city.

Then drag out the keyboard to type.

Medusa: Going out.

Qianhua Charming: Okay, next time I’ll teach you how to fight Mad Sword.

Medusa: No.

Medusa: Learn, gun shooting.

Then she pulled out the card and logged out, took her jacket and put it on her team uniform, went out and went downstairs to take a taxi to the airport.

In the future professional arena, she will meet Wang Jiexi and Huang Shaotian, but she is eyeing Zhou Zekai.

It's not because of the two people's similar ancestry and different fates.

Zhou Jialan is not that boring. She finally waited for a chance to turn her fortune around, and all she wants to do now is live well.

Pay attention to Zhou Zekai, because Zhou Zekai’s debut year is closest to hers, and his personality is also the most similar to hers. He has beautiful actions and a beautiful face.

If you can beat him, you will gain the most.

She was very lucky and found a very powerful sparring partner. Zhou Zekai was now very popular, but Zhou Jialan didn't think that Zhou Zekai would be any better than Zhang Jiale.
